user.title: LU-Alert (Luxembourg)
user.description: Alerts of the official Luxembourg LU-Alert system. More options (language, location, keywords, allergens) are in the options of the integration.

data_description.min_severity: Alerts below this level are ignored by the whole integration.
Alerts below this level are ignored by the whole integration.
data_description.language: The language of the headline and description. Falls back to English, then to any language of the message.
data_description.location_mode: "Flag" marks the alerts that cover your location. "Only" hides alerts that do not. An alert without any area is always kept.
data_description.latitude: Leave latitude and longitude empty to use the location of your Home Assistant.
data_description.longitude: Leave latitude and longitude empty to use the location of your Home Assistant.
data_description.watchlist_keywords: Comma separated words. The "Watchlist Match" sensor is on while an alert mentions one of them (any language, headline, event, description or instruction).
data_description.allergens: The "Allergen Match" sensor is on while an alert mentions one of them. Other words can be typed in.
data_description.show_test_alerts: Test and exercise messages are shown with the severity "Test" instead of being left out.

error.location_incomplete: Enter both latitude and longitude, or leave both empty.
